appDescription: A convoy travel app that shares participating vehicles' progress and helps drivers review common stop proposals.

function.name: SHOW_CONVOY_STATUS
function.description: Return the TMAP traffic-based estimated arrival time spread for convoy vehicles.

function.name: FIND_MEETING_PLACES
function.description: Compare shared stopping places using TMAP road detours and waiting times. Parking capacity is unverified.

query.description: Optional place name or search keyword.

parking_cars.description: Requested parking capacity; availability requires confirmation.

function.name: REVIEW_CONVOY_PROPOSAL
function.description: Open the pending shared stop proposal for the driver to explicitly approve or decline on screen.
